lines: Project — specific Vicuña CuEq information is presented on a 100 % project basis and uses the fixed prices of US $ 4 . 60 /lb for copper, US $ 3 , 300 /oz for gold and US $ 40 /oz for silver, consistent with the consensus forecasts applied in the Vicuña Integrated Technical Report 2026 , dated 16 February 2026 (the “Vicuña PEA”) .
